image_urls.description: image_url(s) EXACTLY as returned by vision_capture or an upload — must start with '/_upload/'. Multiple = temporal sequence. A single string is also accepted. A film (.mp4: `film_url` of vision_capture, `film_urls` of vision_query_events) goes in ALONE.

prompt.description: Question or instruction for the VLM. If omitted, the configured default prompt is used.

source_id.description: Source of the image (from the capture result) — applies the per-camera briefing. Optional.
